chapter.verse: Zedekiah in a uk kum sawmna, a kha sawm, a ni sawm-le-nih ni-in Topa in kei kiangah thu hong gen a,
“Ezekiel aw, Izipt kumpipa Faro’ lam nga in la, amah leh Izipt gam khempeuh daan a kipiak nading thu genkhol in.

Topa Pasian in hih bangin gen hi, ci-in Izipt kumpipa Faro kiangah gen in: Gun sungah a om, awle lianpi ahi, nang Izipt kumpipa aw, keimah in nangma lang ka hi hi. Nail Gunpi, nangma aa in na gen a, nangma bawlsa-in na ngaihsun hi.
Na khaguh-ah sikkawi ka bulh ding a, na gun sunga ngasa om khempeuh nangma tungah ka belhsak ding hi. Tua ciangin na tunga ngasa belh khempeuh tawh Nail gun sung panin nang kong kaikhia ding hi.
Nangmah leh na ngasa khempeuh gamlakah kong pai ding hi. Leilakah na pumpi kiphah ding a, phum lohin hong kikoih ding hi. Ganhingte leh huihlak vasate’ an dingin nang ka hong pia ding hi.

Tua ciangin Topa ka hihna thu Izipt mi khempeuh in thei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh nangmah in Israel mite’ muan’ leh suan’ khat na hi ngei a, ahi zongin nangmah in a khauh lo pumpeng kung khat bang na hi lel hi.
Nangma tungah amaute hong kingap uh ciangin nang na kitan a, amaute sunin na puksak hi.
Tu-in Topa Pasian in nang kiangah kong genin ah: Namsau tawh mi kong simsak ding a, na mite leh na ganhingte thatlum mang ding uh hi.
Izipt gam khempeuh a kinusia gam simtham suak ding a, tua ciangin Topa ka hihna thu na thei ding hi. Nangmah in Nail Gunpi in keima aa hi a, keima bawlsa hi, ci na hih manin,
keimah in nangmah leh na Nail Gunpi langah ka pang hi. Izipt gam khempeuh, leilu lam Migdol khuapi panin leitaw lam Siene khuapi, Ethiopia gamgi dong, a kinusia gamkhing ka suaksak ding hi.
Na gam sung teng mihing in ahi a, ganhing in ahi zongin sik nawn lo ding hi. Kum sawmli sung bangmah om lo ding hi.

Leitung gam khempeuh lakah Izipt gam pen a gamkhing penin ka bawl ding hi. Kum sawmli sung khuapi sia dang khempeuh sangin a sia zaw-in Izipt khuapite ka bawl ding hi. Izipt mite galtai-in ka bawl ding a, gam khempeuh leh minam dang khempeuhte kiangah tai-in ka kithehthang sak ding hi.
“Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa Pasian in hih bangin ka ci hi: Kum sawmli khit ciangin a kithehthangna minamte lak panin Izipt mite ka kaikhawm kik ding a,
amaute’ piancilna mun Izipt khanglam Pathros gamah ka teengsak ding hi. Tua lai-ah kumpi gam gina loin om ding uh a,

kumpi gam khempeuh lakah a gina lopen suak ding uh a, minam dang kuamah uk zo nawn lo ding uh hi. A gina lo mahmah-in bawl ding ka hih manin amau’ deih bangin minam dang khat beek tasak zo lo ding uh hi.

Israel mite in muan’ leh suan’ in amaute nei kik ngei nawn lo ding uh hi. Iziptte a tuahsiat ciangin a suang khial kha ahih lamtak uh Israel mite in a phawk ding uh hi. Tua ciangin Topa Pasian ka hihna thu Israel mite in thei ding uh hi,” hong ci hi.
Zedekiah in a uk a kum sawmnih-le-sagih kum, a kha masa a ni masa ni-in Topa in kei kiangah thu hong gen a,

“Ezekiel aw, Babilon kumpipa Nebukhadnezzar in, Tai-ar khuapi sim hi. A galkapte, nakpi takin hanciam sak lua ahih manin a sam nangawn uh pulhmangin a liangkote uh a sa nangawn lengkhia gawp a, ahi zongin tua bangin amau’ gim thamanin kumpipa leh a galkapte in bangmah phattuamna ngah lo uh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Topa Pasian ahi keimah in hih bangin thu kong gen hi: Tu-in Tai-ar khuapi a simna hangin Babilon kumpipa Nebukhadnezzar tungah Izipt gam ka pia ding hi. Amah in Izipt gam luhin a nate uh sut ding a, a galkapte’ thaman dingin Iziptte’ neihsa khempeuh pua khia mang ding hi.
A galkapte in keima adingin na hong sepsak uh ahih manin, ama hong nasep sak ka thukkikna-in ama tungah Izipt gam a pia ka hi hi. Topa Pasian ahi keimah in hih thu ka gen khin hi.

“Hih thu hong tun’ ciangin Israel mite a thahat minamin ka bawl kik ding a, mi khempeuh’ zak nading munah nang thu kong gensak ding hi. Tua ciangin Topa ka hihna thu amaute in hong thei ding uh hi,” hong ci hi.
